name: Hipersign Licence
description: What this client's licence allows — set by Hipersign (super admins only).

fields.label: Valid until
fields.description: Shown as a reminder to super admins; nothing is locked when it passes.

fields.label: Users allowed
fields.description: Desk users who can log in. 0 = no limit. Not counted: Administrator, super admins, portal customers and driver-only logins.

fields.label: Only the modules ticked on the Super Admin page
fields.description: Off = every module may be switched on in Hipersign Settings › Features.

fields.label: Licensed modules
fields.description: Feature keys, set on the Super Admin page.

fields.label: Show Frappe and ERPNext pop-ups to the client's admins too
fields.description: Off (default): update notices, "What's new", onboarding tours and Frappe prompts appear only for super admins. Errors and validation messages always show.
